headline: Bank of Africa: group net profit rises 13% at end of September
summary: Bank of Africa reported group net income of $340.5 million at the end of September 2026, up 13% from a year earlier. The bank operates across several African markets, including Morocco.
why: Bank of Africa is a pan-African lender, so its profit trends reflect credit demand and financial conditions across several African economies.
original_headline: Bank of Africa : le bénéfice net du groupe progresse de 13% à fin septembre
